title: A quick guide to the quizzes
description: Learn how question cards, navigation, skipped questions, early submission, and retakes work.

sections.title: Answer one card at a time
sections.body: Choose a quiz and start with the first question card. Select one answer, then use Next to continue. Previous lets you revisit earlier cards and change a selection. The progress display shows how many questions you have answered, so you can distinguish navigation from completion.
bullets: There is no timer or account requirement.
You can leave a question unanswered and return to it.

sections.title: Submit when you are ready
sections.body: You can submit after answering at least one question. If questions remain unanswered, a dialog explains that the results may not be fully accurate. Choose Keep answering to continue or Submit anyway to see a partial result. Submitting a partial quiz is optional.
bullets: An unanswered question is not marked as a wrong answer.
Partial accuracy is calculated only from answered questions.

sections.title: Review and try again
sections.body: The result shows completion, accuracy on answered questions, and explanations for each item. Use the suggested lesson to review a topic. Retake starts a fresh attempt. Answers are held in the current page session and are not sent to an AI service or saved to an account.
bullets: Reloading the page resets the current attempt.
Keep results private if you use a shared device.

example.title: A partial attempt
example.text: If you answer four of six questions and get three right, the result shows 4 of 6 answered and 75% accuracy on answered questions. It clearly labels the attempt incomplete.

exercise: Open a quiz, answer one question, and inspect the early-submission warning before deciding whether to continue.

faq.question: Can I submit before finishing?
faq.answer: Yes, after at least one answer. You will see a warning before an incomplete attempt is submitted.

faq.question: Are my answers saved?
faq.answer: No account or server-side answer history is created. The current attempt resets when you reload or leave the page.
